entities.name: Spirit
entities.description: A creature type for ghosts, kami and other ethereal entities, most being the restless souls of the dead.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Otherworldly spirit manifestations of Kamigawa inspired by Shinto kami.

entities.name: Glitch ghosts
entities.description: Corrupted ghosts of those who died outside the House before Valgavoth's Ascension, trapped in their moment of death and hard to defeat except with ghost-catchers.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demon whose Ascension transformed Duskmourn into a house and pushed the spirit realm to the plane's edges.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane turned into an infinite house where spirits became glitch ghosts.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane whose spirits, called geists, are centered in white and blue.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The guardian angel of Innistrad who ushered spirits of the departed into the aether before her madness.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan summoned to Innistrad, prompting benevolent geists to bond with cathars.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: A group formed from the union of benevolent geists and cathars to resist Emrakul's corruption.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school on Arcavios whose Lorehold wizards call upon the spirits of the ancient dead.

entities.name: Lorehold
entities.description: The Strixhaven college whose mages summon and study spirits, including at the Fields of Strife.

entities.name: Fields of Strife
entities.description: A site in the Tor-Kathorra desert of a perpetual battle fought by restless spirits of the Blood Age.

entities.name: Lumarets
entities.description: Small magical spirits native to Titan's Grave that combine their powers for growth, healing, protection and attack.

entities.name: Abzan Houses
entities.description: A Tarkir clan that calls on ancestral spirits through its Kin-Trees.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The dragonlord who outlawed trafficking with spirits as necromancy in the new timeline.

entities.name: Kin-Trees
entities.description: Abzan family trees that act as hubs for ancestral spirits.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane where Abzan spirit magic differs between timelines.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose guilds, notably the Azorius, Orzhov and Dimir, deal with spirits.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: A guild ruled by an aristocracy of undead ghosts forming the Deathless.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A guild that uses spirits as untiring bureaucrats and protectors of the Guildpact's laws.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: A guild that uses ancient spirits as spies and infiltrators.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane whose spirits are called eidolons, severed from the faceless Returned.

entities.name: Eidolons
entities.description: Spectral embodiments of the lost identity of the Returned, drawn to nymphs.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane whose spirits belong to the realm of Istfell.

entities.name: Istfell
entities.description: The Kaldheim afterlife of the ignoble dead not worthy of Starnheim.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane with vampiric revenants, ghost pirates and Echoes.

entities.name: Echoes
entities.description: Spirits of Ixalan bound to a focus object, often a jade mask.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane where mana can trap souls and elves and kor practice ancestor worship.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: A plane where the Custodi can anchor a person's soul to create a spirit.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: A group on Fiora able to keep a person's soul anchored to the physical world.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane where Emissary spirits embodied virtues, none seen since the Vanishing.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The dark phase of Lorwyn in which dormant spirits emerge.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon listed as possibly a spirit.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: A character listed as temporarily a spirit.

events.summary: Valgavoth's Ascension transforms Duskmourn into a house and pushes the spirit realm to the plane's edges.
events.quote: After Valgavoth 's Ascension and the transformation of Duskmourn into an infinitely large house, that realm was pushed to the edges of the plane.

events.summary: Avacyn ushers spirits into the aether until her absence and madness leaves many clinging to the world of the living.
events.quote: In her absence—and later her madness—many spirits cling to the world of the living

events.summary: When Emrakul is summoned, benevolent geists bond with cathars, forming the Order of Saint Traft.
events.quote: the Order of Saint Traft was formed from this union.

events.summary: Dromoka outlaws trafficking with spirits as necromancy, and the practice is restored after Dromoka is overthrown.
events.quote: and when Dromoka was overthrown, it was officially restored.

events.summary: Some Abzan spirits abandoned during Dromoka's reign turn malevolent and form ancestral maelstroms.
events.quote: Some Abzan spirits became malevolent after being abandoned during Dromoka's reign.

events.summary: Since the Vanishing, no spirits have been observed on Mirrodin.
events.quote: Since the Vanishing , no spirits have been observed.

relations.note: summons and consults spirits of the ancient dead
relations.quote: The Lorehold wizards of Strixhaven on Arcavios supplement their study of history by calling on the spirits of the ancient dead.

relations.note: ruled by an aristocracy of undead ghosts
relations.quote: The Orzhov are ruled by an aristocracy of undead ghosts that form the highest council of the guild

relations.note: uses spirits as bureaucrats and law protectors
relations.quote: The Azorius utilize spirits as untiring bureaucrats and protectors of the laws of the Guildpact.

relations.note: uses spirits as spies and infiltrators
relations.quote: The Dimir use them as spies and infiltrators

relations.note: Kin-Trees are hubs for their ancestors' spirits
relations.quote: Each family's Kin-Tree was a hub for its ancestors' spirits.
trafficking with spirits was outlawed as necromancy by the Dromoka

relations.note: can anchor a soul to create a spirit
relations.quote: the Custodi can keep a person's soul anchored to the physical world, creating a spirit.

relations.note: geists and cathars united against Emrakul's corruption
relations.quote: several benevolent geists bonded with cathars to protect them from the corruption and madness spread by the titan
